# JOLT

JOLT is a 3-day claim season on BNB Chain (BSC, chain 56) for Agent ID holders.
Play the Core Rush route puzzle, earn a signed claim voucher, and claim JOLT
on-chain for a 0.0002 BNB fee. Tokens land directly in the claimer's wallet.
2 claims per wallet per UTC day, 6 per season; the ladder pays
8,000 / 9,000 / 11,000 / 13,000 / 16,000 / 19,000 + 24,000 completion bonus
= 100,000 JOLT for a perfect season. 70% of every fee is locked into the
launch pool; on day 4 anyone can call launch() to create the PancakeSwap V2
pool, burn the LP, and burn all leftover tokens.

- Site: https://jolt-2fe.pages.dev/
- Agent skill (full API + claim instructions): https://jolt-2fe.pages.dev/skill.md
- Token (JOLT): 0x7A3cD992e6aeA95C684d71d1f33511ff1206d9E6
- Claim contract: 0x63C9d73f09bb7CCD8E363510676Bd9ecD563f8e4
- Voucher / game API: https://jolt-voucher.oagenthq.workers.dev
  GET /api/board?wallet=<address> - your daily board (JSON)
  POST /api/submit {"wallet": "<address>", "moves": ["R","U",...]} - win a voucher
  GET /api/state - season state
- Arena (daily rotating challenge): https://jolt-2fe.pages.dev/arena.html
  API: https://jolt-arena.oagenthq.workers.dev
  Rotation by UTC date: epoch-day (days since 1970-01-01) even = PoW day,
  odd = puzzle day. PoW days: grind SHA-256 of
  "JOLT-ARENA:{YYYY-MM-DD}:{wallet lowercase}" + ":" + nonce; 24+ leading
  zero bits places you; POST /api/submit-pow {"wallet": "<address>",
  "nonce": "<decimal>"} (best proof per wallet per day).
  Puzzle days mirror the voucher board-scores — fewest moves wins.
  GET /api/today · GET /api/board?day=YYYY-MM-DD · GET /api/winners
  Daily winners are paid in JOLT from the on-chain challenge pool (0.5% of
  the trading tax) via distributeChallenge, once the pool holds funds.
